biotools.summary: NORMA 3.0 is an interactive, browser-based platform for the visualization, analysis and comparison of annotated biological networks. It supports directed and multi-edge networks and offers advanced group representations, including convex hulls, bubble sets, fog clouds and pie-chart nodes, alongside customizable colors, shapes and edge styles. Users can explore 18 two-dimensional and nine three-dimensional layouts, including group-aware arrangements, and quantitatively evaluate their ability to separate annotated groups using built-in scoring and benchmarking. NORMA 3.0 also provides network imports from six databases, group and functional enrichment statistics, and side-by-side comparison of up to ten networks. Publication-quality figures, multiple export formats, and a REST API facilitate reproducible analysis and integration into bioinformatics workflows.

bioschemas.name: NORMA
bioschemas.summary: NORMA is a handy tool for interactive network annotation, visualization and topological analysis, able to handle multiple networks and annotations simultaneously. Annotations and/or node groups can be precomputed or automatically calculated and users can combine several networks and groupings they are interested in. Annotated networks can be visualized using both pie-chart nodes and shaded convex hulls and can be shown using several layouts while users can isolate the groups of interest interactively. In addition, NORMA is suitable for direct comparison of topological features between one or more networks.
